description: This file defines an Error Boundary React component that handles runtime errors in React components, displaying an error message and options to report the issue or reset data.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, logs those errors, and displays a fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with default error state.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Error handling method invoked after an error is thrown in a child component; updates state with error info.

methods.name: clearAndSaveData
methods.description: Exports sync store data, clears local storage, and reloads the page to reset application state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the error UI with options to report or reset, or the child components if no error occurred.
